note: Testnet shortcut T12 trust roots: public Ed25519 application keys, never chain keys. The native validator (package.trusted_keys) and the coordinator Worker (PACKAGE_PUBLIC_KEY, RECEIPT_PUBLIC_KEY, AUTHORIZATION_PUBLIC_KEY) are configured with these; the eval Worker signs manifests, packages, targets and receipt indexes only under them. A verifier pins these keys, never the keys.json a cohort publishes beside its package.

earlier_eval_keys.note: The eval Worker's own keys before it signed under the T12 roots (until 2026-10-30). No configured validator trusts them; the two cohorts below verify only under them.
